name: WordCraft
tagline: Open source word processor — a clean-room Microsoft Word alternative in pure Rust.
description: WordCraft is an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft Word, written in pure Rust by the ArtCraft team. Like all Crafting Apps it is young and moving fast — check the Install panel for current downloads.

zh.tagline: 开源文字处理器——纯 Rust 干净重写的 Microsoft Word 替代品。
zh.description: WordCraft 是 ArtCraft 团队用纯 Rust 编写、对 Microsoft Word 做干净重写（clean-room）的开源文字处理器。和所有 Crafting Apps 一样年轻而迭代飞快——当前下载见安装面板。
